name: Sámi Center for Contemporary Art (Sámi Dáiddaguovddáš)
funding: 2025 revenue NOK 7.9M; Sámi Parliament direct grant NOK 6.09M (2025), plus Troms og Finnmark county.
watch: Sámi contemporary art centre, founded 1986, a foundation since 2013. The director and several board members changed over 2025-26.
records_note: Audited accounts for 2023 to 2025 are in Norway's accounts register; the site lists the full board but no annual reports or funders.

name: Sa Sa Art Projects
funding: Artist-run. Funding found: an online artist auction (2022), documenta fifteen money for a community studio, and a Rei Foundation partnership from 2018 to 2024. No funder list is published.
watch: Founded 2010 by the collective Stiev Selapak. Moved after the White Building was demolished in 2017.
records_note: Its site returned an authorization error, so reports, accounts, funders and board could not be checked; Rei Foundation and documenta fifteen are named elsewhere.

name: Salonul de proiecte
funding: AFCN Romania, ERSTE Foundation, Foundation for Arts Initiatives; non-profit curatorial initiative.
watch: Curatorial initiative in Palatul Universul; it holds research exhibitions and is custodian of the Mihai Oroveanu Image Collection.

name: SALT Galata & SALT Beyoğlu
funding: Founded and funded by Garanti BBVA (bank) since 2011.
records_note: SALT publishes no reports or board itself; parent Garanti BBVA posts reports 2000 to 2025, accounts and a board list; SALT names supporters.

name: Salzburger Kunstverein
funding: City of Salzburg, Land Salzburg, BMKÖS; artist-governed non-profit art association.
watch: Founded in 1844 and housed in the 1885 Künstlerhaus Salzburg. Shows experimental international contemporary art.

name: Samstag Museum of Art
funding: Adelaide University museum, founded in 2007 by the University of South Australia. The Samstag bequest funds scholarships it administers. Partners: Adelaide Festival, Adelaide Film Festival, The Lane Vineyard.
watch: A 2024 encampment targeted the University of Adelaide, then a separate university from the museum's own.
records_note: Samstag shows partner logos without dates and names a seven-person board; no annual report or accounts were found, and the university's Council is listed.

name: Sàn Art
watch: Independent artist-run space in Vietnam, founded in 2007 by Dinh Q. Lê, Tuan Andrew Nguyen and Phnam Thao Nguyen.
records_note: san-art.org has an expired certificate and was not opened; 2014 to 2018 coverage names a board chair but no annual report.

name: Sapporo International Art Festival
funding: SIAF2027 is organised by the City of Sapporo's executive committee, supported by Japan's Agency for Cultural Affairs, the Kao Foundation and partners including Wacom.
watch: Municipal festival. Kao Foundation (consumer goods) and Wacom (electronics) are the named corporate money.
records_note: Sapporo's city site posts the festival committee's reports and settled accounts for FY2020 to FY2024, its member roster of May 2025, and named partners.

name: Sarjeant Gallery
funding: Whanganui District Council ($26.1M) led the NZ$79.4M rebuild with the Ministry for Culture and Heritage, Lottery Grants Board, Provincial Growth Fund, Stout Trust and other unnamed trusts.
watch: Nearly NZ$11M came from community and private trusts and individuals, mostly unnamed. No Lion Foundation, Pub Charity, NZCT or SkyCity is named.
records_note: Parent Whanganui District Council posts audited annual reports 2017 to 2025; the gallery's partners page names funders and its Trust page names nine trustees.

name: Savannah Centre for Contemporary Art (SCCA Tamale)
records_note: No reports, accounts or funder list found; the site lists individuals who collaborated and supported it, in no order or date, and names no board.

name: SAVVY Contemporary: The Laboratory of Form-Ideas
funding: Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion Berlin, Kulturstiftung des Bundes; independent non-profit cultural initiative.
